title: Water from the Rock

questions.question: Who died and was buried at Kadesh?
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:1 (ESV): "And Miriam died there and was buried there."

questions.question: What did the people complain about at Kadesh?
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:2 (ESV): "Now there was no water for the congregation..."

questions.question: What did God command Moses to do to the rock?
options: Tell the rock before their eyes to yield its water
questions.correctAnswer: Tell the rock before their eyes to yield its water
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:8 (ESV): "Tell the rock before their eyes to yield its water."

questions.question: What did Moses do instead?
options: Struck the rock with his staff twice
questions.correctAnswer: Struck the rock with his staff twice
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:11 (ESV): "And Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock with his staff twice..."

questions.question: What was God's punishment for Moses and Aaron?
options: They would not bring the assembly into the land
questions.correctAnswer: They would not bring the assembly into the land
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:12 (ESV): "Because you did not believe in me... you shall not bring this assembly into the land..."

questions.question: What was the name of the water?
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:13 (ESV): "These are the waters of Meribah..."

questions.question: Which king refused Israel passage through his territory?
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:14, 18 (ESV): "Moses sent messengers... to the king of Edom... But Edom said... You shall not pass..."

questions.question: What relationship did Israel claim with Edom?
Who succeeded Aaron as high priest?
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:26 (ESV): "Strip Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son."

questions.question: How long did the house of Israel mourn for Aaron?
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:29 (ESV): "...they wept for Aaron thirty days..."

questions.question: Moses called the people what name at the rock?
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:10 (ESV): "Hear now, you rebels; shall we bring water for you out of this rock?"

questions.question: Did Edom come out to fight Israel?
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:20 (ESV): "And Edom came out against them with a large army..."

questions.question: The highway Israel wanted to take was called?
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:17 (ESV): "We will go along the King's Highway..."

questions.question: What did God say Moses and Aaron failed to do?
options: Uphold me as holy in the eyes of the people
questions.correctAnswer: Uphold me as holy in the eyes of the people
questions.explanation: Numbers 20:12 (ESV): "...to uphold me as holy in the eyes of the people of Israel..."

key_verse_text: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, 'Because you did not believe in me, to uphold me as holy in the eyes of the people of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land...'
